candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to medical and academic titles, professions, and degrees.
This vector activates on words and proper nouns related to higher education institutions, universities, and academic organizations.
This vector activates for academic disciplines and scholarly titles, particularly philosophy and science.
This vector represents abstract concepts related to manner, form, type, or general categories of things.
This vector represents terms related to testing, research, and experimentation across multiple Romance languages.
This feature vector activates on names of prestigious universities, academic institutions, and associated scholarly entities.
The tokens represent words that describe the genuineness, exactness, or true nature of something.
These tokens represent two-letter capitalized abbreviations or corporate/organizational suffix codes.
This feature vector represents the concepts of state governance, political administration, and sovereign authority across multiple languages.
This vector represents forms, derivations, and morphological variations of the Spanish verb "estar" (to be) alongside related existential or state-of-being terms.
